id.hard_test.accept_good.desc: good frames accepted as the right kind

id.hard_test.false_accept_bad.desc: bad frames accepted (motion blur, half out of frame, glare over the read region, defocus)

id.hard_test.accepted_wrong.desc: good frames accepted with the wrong kind or a wrong field

id.hard_test.fields_exact.desc: fields of good frames exactly right (letters and digits, upper case)

id.hard_test.mrz_pass.desc: passport good frames: MRZ read with every check digit passing

id.hard_test.by_kind.desc: per document kind (good accepted, fields right, bad accepted)

id.hard_test.by_condition.desc: per condition: good frames fully right / bad frames rejected

id.speed.fast_ms.desc: native, 1 thread, median over 3 runs: fast pass per frame: outline, flatten, quality, barcodes

id.speed.ocr_ms.desc: native, 1 thread, median over 3 runs: OCR pass per frame (orientation search included)

wasm.single.barcodes_ms.desc: headless Chrome, single wasm (1 thread): barcodes(): every barcode in a camera frame

wasm.single.id_fast_ms.desc: headless Chrome, single wasm (1 thread): document() without OCR: the fast pass

wasm.single.id_ocr_ms.desc: headless Chrome, single wasm (1 thread): document() with OCR

wasm.single.poa_page_ms.desc: headless Chrome, single wasm (1 thread): page(): proof-of-address outline and quality per frame

wasm.single.face_track_ms.desc: headless Chrome, single wasm (1 thread): FaceScanner.track(): detect, mesh, pose, quality per frame

wasm.threads8.barcodes_ms.desc: headless Chrome, threads8 wasm (8 threads): barcodes(): every barcode in a camera frame

wasm.threads8.id_fast_ms.desc: headless Chrome, threads8 wasm (8 threads): document() without OCR: the fast pass

wasm.threads8.id_ocr_ms.desc: headless Chrome, threads8 wasm (8 threads): document() with OCR

wasm.threads8.poa_page_ms.desc: headless Chrome, threads8 wasm (8 threads): page(): proof-of-address outline and quality per frame

wasm.threads8.face_track_ms.desc: headless Chrome, threads8 wasm (8 threads): FaceScanner.track(): detect, mesh, pose, quality per frame
